name: London
agency: UK Met Office / CEDA MIDAS Open
note: MIDAS Open offers daily station observations, but its official catalogue requires a registered CEDA account and login. No authenticated download or qualifying central-London series was obtained.

name: Rome
note: SCIA documents downloadable daily station time series and metadata, but the daily station and time-series links currently lead to its maintenance page. A qualifying Rome daily baseline was not obtained; no registration or payment requirement was verified.

name: Athens
note: Accepted Thissio daily observations: all 10,958 baseline days for both temperature and rainfall; 1.45 km from the reference point and 8 m higher. Official metadata documents no station relocations. No per-record quality flags are supplied; instrument changes and observation-day timing are disclosed.

name: Santorini
note: HNMS's official service portal routes raw meteorological and climate data through an application and normally a fee, with specified research/public-sector exemptions. Its public climate page supplies summaries; no qualifying Santorini daily 1991–2020 baseline was obtained.

name: Dubrovnik
note: DHMZ provides an explicit meteorological-data request form and states delivery follows an offer and payment, with academic/research exceptions. Its public climate tables are monthly values and extremes, which cannot replace the daily distributions required here.

name: Prague
note: Accepted Praha Karlov public daily CSVs after excluding every quality code except Good. Lowest calendar-month coverage is 86.32% for paired temperature and 88.78% for rainfall. Both documented station positions pass 15 km/150 m limits; the 2003 location change is retained in provenance.

name: Istanbul
note: MGM's official archive route is the MEVBİS data-ordering system, listed under paid products with payment and order instructions. No order was placed and no qualifying Istanbul daily baseline was obtained.

name: Marrakech
agency: Direction Générale de la Météorologie, Morocco
note: DGM confirms it provides daily station temperature and rainfall time series as climate services. The reviewed page supplied no public daily download or explicit access/fee requirement; a qualifying Marrakech baseline remains unverified.

name: Cairo
note: The official site was checked, but no public historical daily station download or explicit data-request/access requirement was verified. This is an unresolved source search, not evidence that observations are unavailable.

name: Petra
note: The official site offers climate averages and records, but no qualifying nearby daily 1991–2020 archive or explicit historical-data access requirement was verified. Monthly averages cannot supply the model's temperature distribution.

name: Dubai
note: NCM lists daily maximum/minimum temperature and rainfall among its services and publishes current daily station reports. A public 1991–2020 daily archive and any required registration/request process were not verified.

name: Cape Town
note: SAWS publishes a specific Climate Data Request contact and lists historical climate data as a commercial service. Its public Recent Climate page contains current reports, not a qualifying 1991–2020 daily archive near central Cape Town. A request/quote is the verified next route; no fee amount or guaranteed station coverage is claimed.

name: Serengeti
note: TMA confirms it collects and archives station rainfall and temperature and supplies climate information. No public daily baseline near the Ikoma reference area or explicit access/request requirement was verified.

name: Zanzibar
note: TMA's climate service is verified, but no public daily 1991–2020 station baseline near Zanzibar City or explicit access/request requirement was verified. The existing nearby NOAA series does not meet the unchanged coverage rules.

name: Victoria Falls
note: The official climate-services page offers forecasts, climate information and a contact route. It does not establish a downloadable daily baseline or a specific historical-data access requirement; qualifying station observations remain unverified.

name: Mauritius
note: MMS explicitly holds daily maximum/minimum temperature and rainfall records and directs climate-data requests to the agency. It states charges apply for extraction, preparation and verification. Coverage and a suitable station near the Port Louis reference point still require verification; no request or payment was made.
